I've reworked the header buttons on the Room of Editors page, but the screenshot I could capture is too low-resolution to confirm the result. The page renders and the header lays out as intended, but the button labels are unreadable at that size. I haven't checked it at your 850px width or looked closely at the spacing.

The change is in `src/routes/personas/index.tsx`:

- **Differentiation:** "+ New editor" stays the dark primary button and "Reset defaults" stays the paper-style secondary. "← Back to desk" is now a plain text link, not a third boxed button.
- **Fit with other buttons:** I removed the `text-sm` and display-serif overrides. Both buttons now use the standard `btn-press` and `btn-paper` styles that the rest of the page uses.
- **Spacing between buttons:** The gap goes from `gap-3` to `gap-4`. The labels no longer wrap, because the group is `nowrap` and non-shrinking.
- **Distance from the text:** The title block and button group are now separated by at least `gap-x-10` and the header's bottom margin is larger. The text takes the remaining width, and the buttons wrap below it on narrow screens.
- **Alignment:** The row is `items-end`, so the buttons line up with the bottom of the subtitle instead of floating at the top.

To check it, open `/personas` at a normal browser size, since my preview was too small to read.

content.text:
The "New editor" form now has a portrait picker, and it shows up in the running app. I haven't tried an actual upload, and the screenshot was too low-resolution to judge how it looks.

In the left column under the icon field there is now a 4:5 preview box, an "Upload portrait" button (it becomes "Change portrait" once an image is set) and a "Remove portrait" link. Picking an image crops it to 4:5, shrinks it to 480×600 and stores it inline with the editor. Clicking Create saves it, and the editor's card on this page shows that image in place of the initials. `tsc` reports no errors in the files I touched.

- **New editors only:** the existing Edit form doesn't have the picker yet. Say if you want it there too.
- **Card only so far:** the image appears on this page's card. The small face medallions elsewhere (live voice desk, margin notes) still look editors up by name and haven't been updated. They would show initials for a custom editor.
- **Static image:** the speaking-jaw animation only works for the five built-in engravings, so custom portraits are still pictures.

The edits are in `src/routes/personas/index.tsx`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/utils/persona-portrait.ts` and `src/components/personas/persona-card.tsx`.
